resources.content:
# Guidelines for Live Python Exam

Please watch the below video before attempting the Python Exam.

#### Learn the importance of the Live Python Exam** Mr. Sashank Gujjula, Co-Founder, NxtWave explained about the Live Python Exam in the below videos: **English: **English Session Video **Telugu: **Telugu Session Video **Notes**: - Attempting the Mock Practice Test is mandatory for every exam. - Be on the mock practice test at least for 15 min to check your laptop/system supports the test environment. - You need not worry about the **completion status** of the Mock Practice test as it is just for device check. Fill out the below form if you encounter any issues while taking the Mock Practice Test. Our team will review your response and help you take the test successfully without any issues.
Here is the form link ##Test Guidelines
**Before The Exam** - Check Test Timings carefully, you can attempt the Test only during the mentioned time slots. - Be ready with your Laptop/Computer at least 10 - 15 minutes before** the test starting time. - Ensure you have a Stable Internet Connection. - Turn off notifications in your system/laptop and keep all your devices on Silent Mode. - Please ensure that your device camera is working prior to the exam. - Ensure that your laptop/computer is fully charged before attempting the Test.
**During The Exam** - Google Chrome is a recommended browser for attempting the Python test. You may face issues while using other browsers. - As the exam is proctored you are not allowed to switch your screen, use a calculator, mobile phone, or any other electronic gadget. - No other person should be present in the room throughout the duration of the test. - It is recommended that you take the test in a well-lit area for effective proctoring. - Please ensure that you are not looking away from the screen during the test. - Do not seek any help from the internet or another person. - Please ensure that you are not communicating with any other person during the test. - If determined to be engaging in malpractice or not following instructions, you will be given two warnings before your test is terminated.
## To Avoid Python Technical Issues follow the below steps
>1. Before attempting the test you must close all tabs and turn off all **notifications** ( ***Browser, App, and Device Notifications like Fully charged, plugged In, etc.***) 2. During the test, do not press any special keys such as Windows key, F12, escape, etc. 3. Before attempting the Exam you should take Python **Mock Practice Test**
**Positioning of the web camera:-** - Ensure that the web camera will capture your face from the neck upwards. Your entire face must be visible. Ensure that the position of it does not cut off part of your face. - If your webcam is built-in, adjust your monitor height if necessary and ensure that the webcam is pointing at your face. - If your webcam is mountable, position it on your monitor so that it is directly facing you. - **If your picture is out-of-focus then you will get the below Error. Ensure that your face is clearly visible on the web camera during the exam.** **Ex:-** - To help you prepare, please refer to the below images which shows an **INVALID** and a **VALID** exam attempt. - Please check if your camera is working properly from any of these websites -

webcamtests.com

 -

onlinemictest.com/webcam-test/

 - Please check if your device is connected only to a single camera. Having multiple camera sources can cause an issue. You can disconnect any other camera devices before starting the exam (Having a built-in cam would be preferable). - It is recommended that you take the test in a well-lit area. - Check if any Antivirus Software / Extension is blocking the camera access. If yes, disable them. - It is better to use a personal Laptop/PC instead of company/organization laptops
**Step:-1** - **How to allow the camera access and resolve the cam issue** - Open Chrome Browser and click on more option on the top right (**⋮**) - Click on **Privacy and Security** and then select **Site settings** later open Camera option. - Select the option that you want as your default setting. - Review your blocked and allowed sites.
**Step:-2** - **How to Disable antivirus on our system** - Click on Start button and search "**Windows Security**" - Select the Windows Security app from the search results - Go to Virus & threat protection, and under Virus & threat protection settings - Select Manage settings. - Switch Real-time protection to Off. >**Note:- Disable the remaining Antivirus & Securities as the same. Ex:** *McAfee… etc* >
**Step:-3** - **How to Disable the extensions on our system** - Open Chrome Browser and click on more option on the top right (**⋮**) - Go to Settings and select ***Extensions*** - Click on the Remove button on which extension that you want to remove. - Confirm by clicking Remove.
**Step:-4** - **How to clear the cache & cookies And Clear browser history** - Open Chrome Browser and click on more option on the top right (**⋮**) - Select settings and click on **Privacy & Security** option. - Choose clear browsing data and select time range **All time** to clear everything. - Select all the below boxes then click on **Clear data.** - Next go to "**Cookies and other site data**" and then select **Allow all cookies** then reload the current page.
**FAQ's** 1. How can I attempt the test**?** **Ans:** As shown in the below image you can find the exam in the **Placement Preparation** on the Home Screen of your Learning Portal. You can attempt the exam only in the mentioned time slot. 2. **I don't have webcam access to my Laptop/Desktop. How should I take the test?** **Ans:** Having a webcam is mandatory to take the test. So, we strongly suggest you to buy a webcam and fix it on your laptop/Desktop Or take a Laptop from your friends or relatives during the test. 3. **What should I learn to attempt the test?** **Ans**: You can revise the concepts till **Dictionaries** in **Python Programming Foundations.** 4. **I don't have a laptop, can I attempt the test on mobile?** **Ans:** You can attempt the test only on a **laptop/desktop and not on mobile**. 5. **Can I use pen and paper or refer to any cheat sheets during the test?** **Ans:** You can **use pen and white paper** but **don't refer any cheat sheets and notes.** 6. **How many times can I attempt the test?** **Ans**: Whenever we schedule the test, you can take it as many times as you like until you get **75 marks.** 7. **I am getting issues while attempting the Mock Practice Test after following Guidelines also. What should I do?** **Ans:** Fill out this form if you encounter any issues while taking the test. Our team will review your response and help you take the test successfully without any issues.
